key_insight: The paper shows that logic-synthesis operator sets can be compressed by deriving certified, source-level operator relations instead of treating actions as opaque choices.
engineering_relevance: By turning implementation guards into deterministic admission gates, the method makes ABC Orchestrate faster while preserving bit-identical outputs and improving circuit quality.
method: Agentic LLM source analysis on pinned ABC and mockturtle implementations to infer operator-level relations
Adversarial audits to check the claimed scope of each relation and certify exactness
Compile source-level conditions into deterministic gates and integrate them into ABC Orchestrate as TACO
evidence_signal: On 66 circuits, two exact gates reduced Orchestrate runtime by 11% with bit-identical outputs; in a held-fixed comparison, TACO used fewer nodes on 14/16 circuits and achieved 1.0% fewer nodes, 3.2% fewer levels, and 2.6x faster runtime on geometric mean.
watch_item: The gains depend on implementation-specific source conditions and pinned tool versions, so portability to other synthesis flows may require re-analysis and re-certification.
paper_title: Rethinking Logic Optimization Operators: Theory-Derived Operator Compression via Agentic Source Analysis
